items.raw_excerpt: RMIT Saigon South has become the first foreign university branch campus licensed in Vietnam, clearing the way for the school to expand its campus and course offerings.
items.summary_en: RMIT Saigon South is the first foreign university campus to get a license in Vietnam. The school can now grow its campus and add more courses.
items.summary_ko: 호치민의 RMIT 사이공 사우스 캠퍼스가 베트남에서 처음으로 외국 대학 캠퍼스 허가를 받았습니다. 이제 학교는 캠퍼스를 넓히고 더 많은 과정을 개설할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Australian university wins Vietnam's first foreign branch campus license
items.title_ko: 호주 RMIT 대학, 베트남 첫 외국 대학 캠퍼스 허가 취득
items.title_original: Australian university wins Vietnam's first foreign branch campus license

items.raw_excerpt: British politics has a long-cherished reputation for attracting the weird and wonderful. But in a pantheon of colorful characters, Count Binface, a man wearing a rubbish bin over his head, is stealing the show. The self-described "intergalactic space warrior" from the fictional planet Sigma IX takes on hardline anti-immigrant politician…
items.summary_en: A man with a rubbish bin on his head is grabbing attention in British politics. Count Binface calls himself an intergalactic space warrior from the fictional planet Sigma IX. He uses his funny act to challenge a hardline anti-immigrant politician.
items.summary_ko: 머리에 쓰레기통을 쓴 남자가 영국 정치에서 화제가 되고 있다. 스스로를 가상의 행성 시그마 나인 출신 '은하계 우주 전사'라고 소개하는 빈페이스 후보는 웃음을 주면서도 강경한 반이민 정치인에 맞서고 있다.
items.title_en: UK joke candidate Binface makes a serious point about politics
items.title_ko: 영국 '개그 후보' 빈페이스, 정치에 진지한 메시지
items.title_original: UK 'joke' candidate Binface pushes serious point about politics

items.raw_excerpt: The popular seasoning from the United States was recently blocked from sale in South Korea. In Singapore, Carousell and Lazada have removed listings of the product and are monitoring for new ones.
items.summary_en: A popular Trader Joe's seasoning from the United States was blocked from sale in South Korea. In Singapore, online stores Carousell and Lazada have removed listings of the product. They are watching for new listings to appear.
items.summary_ko: 미국에서 인기 있는 Trader Joe's 양념이 한국에서 판매 금지됐다. 싱가포르의 온라인 쇼핑몰 카루셀과 라자다도 이 제품의 판매 목록을 내렸다. 새 등록이 올라오는지 모니터링하고 있다.
items.title_en: Popular Trader Joe's seasoning removed from sale over poppy seeds
items.title_ko: 인기 Trader Joe's 양념, 금지된 양귀비 씨 이유로 판매 중단
items.title_original: Online listings of popular Trader Joe's seasoning removed on CNB’s order over prohibited poppy seeds

items.raw_excerpt: Revenue generated by parking fees at public hospitals has more than doubled over a four-year period.
items.summary_en: Parking fees at public hospitals in Ireland now bring in more than twice as much money as they did four years ago. The revenue from parking has grown sharply over that period.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 공립 병원의 주차 요금 수익이 4년 전보다 두 배 이상 늘어났습니다. 주차 요금으로 벌어들인 수입이 그동안 크게 증가했습니다.
items.title_en: Hospital parking fee revenue doubles in four years
items.title_ko: 공립 병원 주차 요금 수익, 4년 만에 두 배로 늘어나
items.title_original: Parking fee revenue at hospitals doubles over four years

items.raw_excerpt: La ida se jugará en Argentina y los piratas quieren ganar para llegar con ventaja a la vuelta en casa.
items.summary_en: Coquimbo Unido will play the first leg in Argentina. The club wants to win and reach the second leg at home with an advantage.
items.summary_ko: 1차전은 아르헨티나에서 열립니다. 코킴보 우니도는 승리해 홈 2차전을 유리하게 치르려고 합니다.
items.title_en: Coquimbo Unido visits Platense hoping to land the first blow in Libertadores round of 16
items.title_ko: 코킴보 우니도, 리베르타도레스 16강에서 플라텐세 원정 첫 승 도전
items.title_original: Coquimbo Unido visita a Platense con la ilusión de dar el primer golpe en octavos de la Liberadores

items.raw_excerpt: A wave of farmers taking up cow collars for managing pasture is driving further growth for technology firm Halter, which now has 1.5 million cows collared up globally.
items.summary_en: More farmers are using cow collars to manage their pasture. This is boosting New Zealand tech firm Halter. Halter now has 1.5 million collared cows around the world.
items.summary_ko: 농장주들이 소 목걸이를 이용해 목초지를 관리하면서 뉴질랜드 기술 기업 헐터가 더욱 성장하고 있습니다. 헐터는 현재 전 세계에서 150만 마리의 소에게 목걸이를 설치했습니다.
items.title_en: Tech firm Halter grows with cow collars and virtual fences
items.title_ko: 소 목걸이로 목초지를 관리하는 기술 기업 헐터가 성장을 이어가
items.title_original: Tech company Halter continues to milk it with virtual fences, cow collars
